title: NeuroSleep Simulated BCI Device Event
description: Versioned source-event envelope for the simulated BCI device stream. Kafka transport metadata such as topic, partition, offset, and consumer ingestion time are intentionally not part of the source payload.

event_id.description: Stable event identity and deduplication key.

event_time.description: UTC time reported by the simulated source device.

sequence_number.description: Source sequence within one device session. It supports ordering diagnostics but is not the deduplication key.

payload.description: Event-type-specific source payload. The envelope remains stable while payload rules can evolve.
